capabilities: Capture selected source text as excerpt cards in a right-side workbench
Attach notes to excerpts or write standalone notes
Search, sort, and jump from excerpt cards back to source text
Sync the workbench into a Markdown note automatically or on demand
Add bidirectional links between the source note and the exported note
disambiguation: Not an automatic summarizer or a rigid reading-note template; it only captures, annotates, and exports excerpts on demand.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Reading and excerpting in one editor mixes source text with captured quotes and comments, and fixed reading-note templates force a rigid structure.
summary: Excerpt-based reading-notes plugin that captures selected text into a side workbench and syncs it into a companion Markdown note.
